integrity: Analytical proof is given; finite hull and integer checks are separately reproducible. No claim of independent certification or external validation.
scientific_limitations: All claims are for the canonical unweighted Euclidean root realization and uniformly sampled ridges; historical priority remains provisional pending independent literature review. Distributional limits do not imply rescaled-moment convergence.
title: Complete Euclidean ridge-angle spectrum and a rare-right-angle variance law for biclique symmetric edge polytopes
